variant.title: Sandwich Sudoku
variant.description: Each boundary clue equals the sum of all digits between 1 and 9 in its row or column.
rule.sandwich: Each boundary clue equals the sum of all digits between 1 and 9 in its row or column.
rule_guide.title: Sandwich Sudoku
rule_guide.item_1: A clue on the top edge belongs to its column; a clue on the left edge belongs to its row.
rule_guide.item_2: Find 1 and 9 in that row or column, then add every digit between them. Do not include 1 or 9.
rule_guide.item_3: For example, in 4 1 3 5 2 8 9 6 7, the digits between 1 and 9 sum to 3 + 5 + 2 + 8 = 18. If 1 and 9 are adjacent, the clue is 0.
